status: reference and public contract reviewed before calibration
hidden_requirement_review: All assertions map to the supplied issue; user callback Decode propagation is explicitly specified.
record_validation: Scan entry headers, detect duplicates before second length, validate lengths and exhaustion, then decode typed tuple in declaration order.
exception_isolation: Private Fault transports parser errors; exported Decode raised by user code is not caught as a parse error. Every propagated exception restores caller cursor.
slice_arithmetic: Headers use checked take; child length compared to stop minus current position before addition. Atom view has exact payload extent and independent local cursor.
stream_arithmetic: 8-byte signed length is checked against zero, OCaml max_int and max_size before subtraction-based available-length comparison.
callbacks: Record and Map callbacks occur only after their own payload exhaustion. Independent reentrant decode and successful cursor overwrite are checked.
native_atom_alias: Reader probe mutates a bounded subview and observes the same mutation in the original buffer, proving aliasing for that probe.
limitations: Heap allocation telemetry does not measure external C allocations; the shared Atom subview probe separately checks aliasing.
Upstream generated fixtures account for a substantial part of the full checkout code count.
No OCaml quality/security analyzer or independent difficulty confirmation is claimed.
